aboutGame.title: What is Dark Machine The Animation?
paragraphs: Dark Machine The Animation is a 2026 original sci-fi esports anime from Project Carbuncle, animated by Production +h. and directed by Kazumi Terada. It follows Kairi, who arrives in Golden Valley carrying his grandfather's final words: Find Senki.

In this world, the competitive game DARK MACHINE has reshaped Japan's economy. Ajima, the seventh Senki, controls Golden Valley through the game, while Kairi becomes a player after meeting Rudora and begins challenging the hierarchy. The series airs on Fuji TV in Japan and streams internationally on Crunchyroll.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Dark Machine The Animation.

items.question: What is Dark Machine The Animation about?
items.answer: Dark Machine The Animation follows Kairi as he enters Golden Valley with his grandfather's final words, Find Senki. After meeting Rudora, he becomes a DARK MACHINE player and challenges the hierarchy ruled by Ajima, the seventh Senki.

items.question: When did Dark Machine The Animation premiere?
items.answer: Dark Machine The Animation premiered on October 13, 2026, as part of the Fall 2026 anime season.

items.question: Where can I watch Dark Machine The Animation?
items.answer: Dark Machine The Animation streams on Crunchyroll with Japanese audio and subtitles, while the series airs on Fuji TV in Japan.

items.question: Who are the main characters in Dark Machine The Animation?
items.answer: Dark Machine The Animation centers on Kairi, Rudora, and Ajima, with Aluk, Denebola, and Spica forming the STELLATUS idol-esports trio.

items.question: Who performs the theme songs for Dark Machine The Animation?
items.answer: BUCK-TICK performs the opening theme Sonzai Riyuu Kai for Dark Machine The Animation, while Sandaime J Soul Brothers performs the ending theme Galaxy Mode.

items.question: How long is each Dark Machine The Animation episode?
items.answer: Each episode of Dark Machine The Animation runs about 22 minutes and the series airs weekly.
